match.footnote: Matches are a starting point, based on Job Bank job titles and national median wages (2023–2024). Your resume is never sent anywhere.

programs.csjSeason.title: Canada Summer Jobs postings go live on Job Bank each spring.
programs.csjSeason.body: Start your search early and apply as soon as they open. A reminder stays on this device only.
programs.reminder.label: Canada Summer Jobs reminder
programs.reminder.detail: Check Job Bank for Canada Summer Jobs postings in March
programs.handoffNote: Search without signing in. You’ll sign in to GC Jobs to apply.
programs.footnote: Eligibility is a first check only; each program’s page has the full rules. Student pay rates effective {date}.
programs.gcjobs.name: Government of Canada jobs
programs.gcjobs.what: Most federal departments post their jobs on GC Jobs. You can search without signing in; you sign in to apply.
programs.why.gcjobs.anyone: Open to everyone. Check each posting’s essential qualifications.
programs.fswep.name: Federal Student Work Experience Program
programs.fswep.what: Paid student jobs in 200+ federal departments and agencies, all year round. {level, select, secondary {Pay starts at {pay} an hour.} post {Pay starts at {pay} an hour in college or CEGEP and {payUni} in university.} other {Pay starts at {pay} to {payUni} an hour, depending on your level of study.}}
programs.why.fswep.student: You qualify if you’re a full-time student going back to full-time studies next term.
programs.why.fswep.graduated: It’s only for students still registered full time. As a graduate, look at GC Jobs postings open to the public.
programs.why.fswep.notStudent: You need to be a full-time secondary or post-secondary student.
programs.why.fswep.needStudent: For full-time students returning to school next term.
programs.csj.name: Canada Summer Jobs
programs.csj.what: Paid summer jobs for youth aged 15 to 30 with employers across Canada. The jobs are posted on Job Bank.
programs.why.csj.inAges: You’re 15 to 30. You also need to be a Canadian citizen, permanent resident or protected person.
programs.coop.name: Post-Secondary Co-op/Internship Program
programs.coop.what: Federal work terms for students whose program requires a co-op or internship.
programs.why.coop.coopProgram: If your program has a required work term, ask your school’s co-op coordinator.
programs.why.coop.postSecondaryOnly: Only for full-time college or university students in a co-op program.
programs.research.name: Research Affiliate Program
programs.research.what: Federal jobs that use the research skills your program teaches.
programs.why.research.researchProgram: If research is part of your program. Look under “Student programs” on GC Jobs.
programs.swpp.name: Student Work Placement Program
programs.swpp.what: Paid work placements with employers in fields like tech, environment, business and more.
programs.why.swpp.postSecondary: For post-secondary students who are citizens, permanent residents or protected persons.
programs.why.swpp.postSecondaryOnly: Only for students at a Canadian college or university.
programs.yess.name: Youth Employment and Skills Strategy
programs.yess.what: Training, paid work experience and support like mentoring for youth facing barriers to work. Call {phone} (TTY {tty}).
programs.why.yess.inAges: You’re in the 15 to 30 age range.
programs.why.yess.inAgesBarriers: You’re 15 to 30. It’s aimed at youth facing barriers to work: check with a service provider.
programs.parks.name: Parks Canada youth jobs
programs.parks.what: Student and youth jobs with Parks Canada.
programs.why.parks.inAges: You’re 15 to 30. Each posting lists its own requirements.
programs.iec.name: International Experience Canada
programs.iec.what: Work and travel abroad through International Experience Canada.
programs.why.iec.outAges: It’s for Canadian citizens aged 18 to 35.
programs.apprentice.name: Apprenticeships in the skilled trades
programs.apprentice.what: Earn while you learn a trade, with most of your time spent training on the job.
programs.why.apprentice.trades: Every province and territory runs its own apprenticeship program.
